slides.title: Truck Fleet Capacity Management
slides.subtitle: Board briefing • Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Limited • Synthetic demonstration

slides.title: Executive Summary
bullets: Synthetic planning case: balance daily dispatch demand against loading capacity.
Illustrative baseline: 42 trucks available, 34 average daily requirement, 8 trucks idle on average.
Recommended decision: pilot demand-based dispatch scheduling before changing fleet contracts.

slides.title: Planning Evidence
slides.quote: Fleet sizing should be reviewed against demand variability, loading slots, turnaround time, and safety constraints.

slides.title: Recommended Pilot
bullets: Introduce a daily dispatch forecast and slot-based truck appointment schedule.
Track utilization, queue time, turnaround time, and late dispatches for four weeks.
Review contracted capacity only after the pilot produces measured utilization data.
No autonomous operational or safety decision is made by this demo.

slides.title: Agent Workflow
bullets: Local presentation compiler: structured plan → editable PPTX
Evidence model: source IDs attached to claims
Verification: slide readability, citations, and review notice

slides.title: Sovereignty and Review Status
bullets: Data in this deck is synthetic and non-confidential.
Artifact generation is local through python-pptx.
Remote Luna is a development-only model endpoint and is not used as proof of sovereignty.
Human review is required before any operational use.
